Hearth Mains VG CHEF

Hearth Burrata & Mission Fig Flatbread

$26

36-hour fermented heritage dough, creamy burrata, roasted figs, mountain thyme, forest honey.

Culinary Story & Sourcing

Milled in-house from Rouge de Bordeaux heritage wheat, fermented cold for 36 hours. Baked at 800°F with roasted Black Mission figs, artisanal Willamette burrata, fresh thyme leaves, and a finishing swirl of raw mountain wildflower honey.

Hearth Method 800°F wood-fired stone oven floor
Sommelier Pairing Lambrusco di Sorbara Frizzante
Nutrition Profile Approx. 620 kcal · 22g Protein · 68g Carbs
Allergen Notice Gluten (wheat), Milk (dairy)

Botanical & Farm Ingredients

🌱 House stone-milled flour 🌱 Fresh artisanal burrata 🌱 Black Mission figs 🌱 Raw mountain honey 🌱 Wild thyme 🌱 Extra virgin olive oil
